datasheet_identity.title: RE1C002UN Nch 20V 200mA Small Signal MOSFET Datasheet

extraction_notes: RE1C002UN is an N-channel 20 V 200 mA small-signal MOSFET; the ordering suffix UNTCL is the taping code variant shown on the title and package data.
The electrical characteristics table gives VGS(th) min 0.3 V and max 1.0 V at VDS = 10 V and ID = 1 mA; no typical threshold value is published.
RDS(on) rows are retained for every published VGS/ID pair, including the Tj = 125 degC row. Typical and maximum values are represented as separate schema points.

The p. 4 output, p. 5 transfer, p. 6 RDS(on), p. 8 capacitance, and p. 8 body-diode curves were manually digitized from the published figures. Points are curve readings, not interpolated vendor or SPICE data.

The source publishes switching times, temperature coefficients, forward transfer admittance, gate/source leakage, IDSS, thermal resistance, and ratings, but these fields are not represented by the strict extraction schema.
The built-in G-S protection diode is described in the features and inner-circuit drawing; the schema body_diode field records the separately tabulated source-drain diode VSD.
omission_reason: Reverse-recovery time is not published. Switching times, thermal resistance, temperature coefficients, forward transfer admittance, leakage, and power/current ratings are present in the PDF but have no fields in the strict extraction schema.
